insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Policy says 'choose the room you like'; however, if room chosen is higher than opted category, proportionate deduction applies. Room type modification (single private or sharing) is an optional feature.

icu.note: ICU always paid up to Base Sum Insured regardless of room type chosen.

copayment.note: Co-payment is an optional feature (Section 4.19); no mandatory co-pay in base plan.

sub_limits.display: Cataract: mono-focal lens only (SI ≤10L); else no sub-limits
sub_limits.note: For Sum Insured up to ₹10 lakh, cataract claims limited to mono-focal lens. No other disease-wise sub-limits stated.

deductible.note: Annual Aggregate Deductible is an optional feature (Section 4.18); base plan has no deductible.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents covered from day 1.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 36 months; can be reduced or increased via optional Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Time Modification (Section 4.20).

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, osteoarthritis, etc.) excluded for 24 months; accidents covered from day 1, cancer after 30-day wait.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses are a standard exclusion (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.display: Booster+: up to 3x/5x/10x Base SI (no-claim carry-forward)
cumulative_bonus.note: Unutilised Base SI carries forward as Booster+ up to 3/5/10 times Base SI depending on plan variant chosen. This is an inbuilt feature, not a traditional % NCB.

restoration.note: ReAssure+ / ReAssureX provides unlimited restoration of up to Base SI per claim, triggered after first paid claim, for life of policy on renewal. Applies to related and unrelated illnesses.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days before admission for the same condition.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 180 days after discharge for the same condition.

day_care.note: Hospitalisation of 2 hours or more covered; day-care procedures under general/local anaesthesia covered.

domiciliary.note: Home Care / Domiciliary Treatment covered with pre & post hospitalisation benefit; medical devices used at home not covered.

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment in recognised AYUSH hospitals covered up to Sum Insured; Yoga & Naturopathy require prior approval; minimum 24-hour admission for AYUSH.

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses for organ donor covered when insured's transplant claim is paid; also covers insured if they donate an organ.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance paid up to Sum Insured; Air ambulance up to ₹2,50,000 per hospitalisation in emergencies only.

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments listed including robotic surgery, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy, oral chemotherapy, etc., covered up to Sum Insured.

consumables.note: Non-payable consumables (List I) covered under optional Safeguard add-on; Lists I–IV covered under Safeguard+.

global_cover.note: Policy covers Allopathic and AYUSH treatments in India ONLY (Preamble). No international cover available.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim contestable except for proven fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly instalment mode.

free_look.note: Free-look period of 30 days from receipt of policy document; applicable on new policies only, not renewals.

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI norms; credits for PED, specific waiting periods, NCB and moratorium transferable.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, dental (non-accident), external congenital anomaly, refractive error <7.5D, infertility/ART, conflict/war, brain-dead life maintenance

optional_riders.display: Hospital Cash, Personal Accident (AD/PTD/PPD), Safeguard, Safeguard+, Room Type Modification, PED Waiting Period Modification, Annual Aggregate Deductible, Co-payment
